## What changes, and why

## How I tested it

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` are clean
- [ ] A behavior change has a test and a line in the README or `docs/`
- [ ] `protocol.py`, `tests/test_protocol.py` and `tests/vectors/` are unchanged, or copied unchanged from ovflowd/torpor
- [ ] No real host names, MAC addresses, keys or codes in fixtures or docs
